description: This file defines mock classes for the IMediaKeys and IMediaKeysFactory interfaces used in the Rialto media framework. It is primarily used for unit testing, providing mock implementations of media key management functionalities.

classes.name: MediaKeysMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IMediaKeys interface for testing media key operations.

classes.name: MediaKeysFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IMediaKeysFactory interface for creating MediaKeys instances.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mocks the selection of a key ID within a media key session.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Mocks checking if a key exists in a session.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Mocks creation of a new media key session.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Mocks generating a license request for a media key session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Mocks loading an existing media key session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Mocks updating a media key session with response data.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Mocks setting DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Mocks closing a media key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Mocks removing a media key session.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the LDL sessions limit.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the last DRM error code for a session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Mocks creation of a new IMediaKeys instance for a given key system.
